notes.title: The Achievements Update Is So Close, You Can Hear It Breathing!
notes.content:
[img=http://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/326420/extras/ACHVART.png?t=1413481963&alt_url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/326420/extras/ACHVART.png?t=1413482007] [/img]

[b]The Achievements Update has landed![/b]

As of 20:00 GMT this very evening, Episode One's Steam Achievements will be available via the v1.0.2 update! Scoop them up before your friends do!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 is Live!
notes.content:
[img=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/326420/extras/controllerupdateart.png?t=1413286309] [/img]

[b]The Controller Update has landed![/b]

As of 14/10/2014, ahead of the official Sam Glyph Oculus Rift patch, v1.0.1 will be available! Included in this update, is support for the Windows Xbox 360 controller, as well as a few nips and tucks to Episode One and additional subtitle fixes.
